name: Absolute Cinema
look: A black-and-white photo of director Martin Scorsese sitting in a white armchair in front of a dark background. He wears a tweed jacket over a dark shirt and holds both hands up beside his head, palms open and fingers spread, with a serious expression.
use: Praises something as a masterpiece, sincerely or ironically. The caption names an epic scene, a perfect moment or something very ordinary, and the raised hands deliver the verdict: absolute cinema.
examples: The toast landing butter side up
My cat knocking a glass off the table while making eye contact
